The Pythagorean theorem is a rule about right-angled triangles. It says that if you have a triangle with one angle that is 90 degrees, then the square of the length of the side opposite that angle (the hypotenuse) is equal to the sum of the squares of the lengths of the other two sides. In other words, if the sides are a, b, and c (with c being the hypotenuse), then a² + b² = c². This helps in calculating the length of one side if you know the lengths of the other two.

6. Cook until the edges are golden brown and the top is bubbly.
7. Flip the pancake and cook for another minute or until golden brown.
8. Serve with syrup, fruit, or other toppings.
